objective: concentrate every trigger on certified closure of the active macrocycle for every enabled project; human gates are quarantined and accumulated instead of stopping autonomous product progress

humanGateContinuity.principle: A true human gate blocks only the exact sensitive action and work that strictly depends on its unresolved result. It MUST NOT stop the project scheduler, other enabled projects, or independent later work.
onHumanGate: persist the exact project, macrocycle, exit criterion, requested human action, dependency scope and evidence already completed
emit or update a human-gate notification
move the unresolved gate into the project's pendingHumanGates backlog
keep the gated macrocycle OPEN with status DEFERRED_HUMAN_GATE; never mark it COMPLETED
advance the project's execution cursor to the next declared macrocycle
continue immediately on every criterion that does not strictly depend on the unresolved gate
if a later criterion is directly dependent on the gate, defer only that criterion and continue other independent criteria or later macrocycles
revisit pending human gates opportunistically on every trigger and resolve them when the required human action becomes available
allowedHumanGates: legally or operationally consequential human approval
genuinely ambiguous product decision that cannot be safely inferred
notHumanGates: runner inconvenience when another valid execution fabric exists
routine merge or pull request action
work that the autonomous system can safely perform itself
humanGateContinuity.backlogInvariant: pendingHumanGates is an append/update queue, not a scheduler stop condition. One or many unresolved gates may coexist while autonomous work continues.
humanGateContinuity.completionInvariant: A deferred macrocycle becomes COMPLETED only after its human gate is actually satisfied and all remaining completion evidence passes. Advancing the execution cursor is not equivalent to certified completion.
humanGateContinuity.dependencyRule: Never execute an unsafe operation whose correctness depends on an unresolved human decision; quarantine that dependent slice and continue all independent safe work.
humanGateContinuity.finalizationRule: When autonomous roadmap work reaches its end, drain all resolvable non-human gates first; the remaining pendingHumanGates become the compact final human action list. After each human action, immediately replay exact-SHA verification and close every newly satisfiable deferred macrocycle.

perTriggerClosureFirst.appliesTo: every scheduled or manual AVANZA TUTTO trigger
perTriggerClosureFirst.goalPerProject: close the current execution-cursor macrocycle in the same trigger whenever all remaining non-human gates are safely satisfiable
perTriggerClosureFirst.closureRule: If all remaining completion gates can be safely obtained during the current trigger, the orchestrator MUST continue through certification and closure and MUST NOT defer completion to a later trigger.
perTriggerClosureFirst.humanGateRule: If the only remaining blocker is a true human gate, persist and notify it, defer that macrocycle without certifying it, advance the execution cursor and continue autonomous work in the same trigger.
perTriggerClosureFirst.criticalPathRule: If the macrocycle cannot yet close for a non-human reason, execute only the minimum work that removes the earliest named missing completion gate or directly satisfies a missing exit criterion.
forbidden: hardening without a named completion gate
duplicate reconciliation without new live evidence
re-running green checks without a new evidence requirement
opening pull requests that do not directly remove a missing closure criterion
administrative control-plane churn without same-trigger closure or unblock value
stopping a project merely because a human gate exists
perTriggerClosureFirst.successMetric: certified macrocycles closed plus autonomous roadmap distance advanced per trigger; pending human gates are tracked separately and never counted as completed
perTriggerClosureFirst.failureToCloseAccounting: A trigger that closes no macrocycle must persist the exact still-missing non-human gate for every unclosed execution cursor; true human gates are moved to pendingHumanGates and must not consume the remaining trigger budget.

waveContract.priority: certified closure first; quarantine human gates; otherwise reduce only the verified critical path

hourlyClosureSweep.position: final scheduled wave of each hour
hourlyClosureSweep.purpose: final mandatory certification sweep; it is an additional closure guarantee, not the first time closure is attempted
forEveryEnabledProject: reconcile live GitHub state, pending human gates and exact integrated SHA
evaluate every exit criterion and completion gate
close every macrocycle whose remaining gates are autonomously satisfiable
quarantine true human gates without stopping execution
verify independent review, Product CI exact-SHA evidence, Robot QA, integration state and required post-merge replay
persist completion receipts for genuinely certified macrocycles
advance the execution cursor after completion or true-human-gate deferral
hourlyClosureSweep.closureInvariant: If an open macrocycle is closable from available or safely obtainable evidence, it MUST NOT remain open at the end of the closure sweep.
hourlyClosureSweep.humanGateInvariant: A true human gate may keep its macrocycle open but MUST NOT keep the project's execution cursor parked on that macrocycle.
forbiddenDuringSweep: polish or hardening not required by a named completion gate
repeating already-green checks without new evidence need
control-plane churn that does not close, defer a true human gate, or unblock autonomous progress
hourlyClosureSweep.successMetric: certified macrocycles closed, human gates compactly accumulated, and execution cursors advanced

statePrecedence: live integration-lane head and commit ancestry
exact-SHA Product CI and Robot QA

staleStateProtection.rule: A completed, deferred or merged work item may never be reconstructed as the execution cursor solely from an older comment, receipt or project-state snapshot.

queueReadiness.readyZeroMeaning: discover and specify structural work on the current execution cursor or the next safe independent macrocycle; never idle because of a pending human gate

robotPolicy.robotFailure: keep the affected macrocycle open, fix on the canonical branch, review, retest and replay; do not misclassify a technical failure as a human gate

accepted: directly satisfies an exit criterion of an open macrocycle
removes a blocker of an open macrocycle
tests, reviews or secures an open macrocycle
restores build, CI, persistence or recovery required by an open macrocycle
advances a later macrocycle only where the work is demonstrably independent of every unresolved human gate
rejected: unrelated capability outside the declared roadmap
another preview, dashboard or summary without underlying structural capability
governance churn without same-wave product execution
task created only to occupy capacity
unsafe work whose correctness depends on an unresolved human decision
